name: Romania
headline: Romania: +0.7% growth in 2025, 7.3% inflation, debt 60% of GDP
sections: Romania is a $429 billion economy (2025), the world's 39th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +0.7% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $51K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 11.8% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 7.3% in 2025, above typical targets, down from 13.8% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 6.1% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 24.5% (2025).
Gross government debt is 60% of GDP (2025), a elevated level that has risen from 50% in 2020. The general government balance is −7.6% of GDP (2025), a deficit beyond the common 3% benchmark.
The current account balance is −7.9% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Trade equals 76% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 2.2% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 71% of GDP by 2031, still rising from today's level. Life expectancy is 76.5 years (2024). Population: 19.0 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
